bugs_found.description: Missing NaN/Inf finiteness checks for position and quaternion. Non-finite values would pass through silently.
bugs_found.fix: Added math.isfinite checks for all position and quaternion values; body quaternions pass through qnorm() for normalization.

bugs_found.description: script_sha256 was listed as variant key, allowing different script hashes between A and B runs.
collection_seed silently fell back to 0 if missing from pilot record.
bugs_found.fix: Added explicit key-missing check that raises CollectionHold.

bugs_found.description: A and C rotation values were not checked for finiteness. Only B rotations were checked.
bugs_found.fix: Added math.isfinite checks for A and C rotation values; non-finite rotations now cause SKIP.

bugs_found.description: Smoke mode with FAIL status exited 0 (contradiction between status label and exit code).
bugs_found.fix: Exit code now follows status_label: 0 for *_PASS, 5 for *_FAIL.

bugs_found.description: FakeModel missing body_parentid, site_bodyid, geom_bodyid attributes.
bugs_found.fix: Added numpy array attributes matching collect_entity requirements.

bugs_found.description: site_xmat and geom_xmat used 2D 3x3 matrices instead of flat 9-element arrays.

remaining_risks: 5 integration tests require EGL/GPU and cannot run on audit machine (pre-existing)
